_comment: A Service made for this probe alone, on the demo organization the other
probes use (isTestAccount, test-mode payments), created and published
through the dashboard's own service editor: `PROBE — deposit, do not book`.
Why each setting is what it is:
$3, $1 deposit   the checkout takes $1 and saves the card; the balance job
charges the other $2 off-session when it falls due.
balance due 1    day before the start. The probe books the first slot a
day and a few minutes ahead, so the balance falls due
minutes after the run and the next run finds it charged.
15-minute slots  open all day, every day, UTC, no notice floor: there is
always a slot close to a day ahead.
no approval      the deposit is charged at checkout, not held.
